news.headline: Panthers put Legette on IR; Coker also likely out vs. Lions
news.detail: The Panthers have placed 2024 first-round pick Xavier Legette on injured reserve ahead of Sunday's primetime matchup against the Lions. Wide receiver Jalen Coker is also unlikely to play against the Lions, sources told ESPN.
